build_init_config: initialize a config dictionary with default values and optionally print the configuration
run_update_config: run argparse-based CLI argument parsing to update a config dictionary from command-line flags
create_write_summary_results: create a function that writes tracking evaluation summary results to a space-delimited text file
create_write_detailed_results: create a function that writes per-sequence tracking evaluation details to a CSV file
test_load_detail: test loading detailed tracker evaluation results from a CSV file into a nested dictionary
